blocks.title: [W-S-16] Nemeton Monastery (The Seraphic Radiance / Yuri's Weapon & Armor / Lottery Member #0)
blocks.text:
Only one side quest left!
- We can get **Yuri**'s best Fusion, as well as his best weapon and armor.
- On top of that, we can finally meet the **Lottery Chairman**.
